item.title: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases
item.description: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.

item.title: When a teen posts a selfie, how much filter is 'too much' filter?
item.description: The recent Meta settlement includes a clause banning "cosmetic procedure filters" for teens. But defining what constitutes an extreme makeover isn't easy.

item.title: AI found the flaw. Hackers found the leak: The race to save 'PHP2SHELL'
item.description: AI discovered a vulnerability in part of the internet's architecture, called PHP2SHELL. Security researchers rushed to fix it, but news of the vulnerability leaked and hackers have swooped in.

item.title: Fired OpenAI researchers say independent safety audits aren't going well
item.description: In their first interview since being fired, OpenAI safety researchers Mikita Balesni and Tomek Korbak say they were terminated for prioritizing safety over the short-term interests of the company.
